title: UK Clean Power 2030 Action Plan & Whitepaper
full_text: Great Britain must more than double its onshore wind capacity to 35 GW, quadruple offshore wind to 55 GW, and expand solar capacity to achieve zero-carbon electricity by 2030. The Secretary of State announces an allocated public capital commitment of £28 billion over five years to de-risk high-voltage transmission lines. Meanwhile, blending hydrogen into domestic residential pipelines remains under experimental safety review and will not be mandated until empirical pilot trials conclude.

full_text: DATA STRUCTURES AND ALGORITHMS (DSA) COMPREHENSIVE LECTURE NOTES Section 1: Linear Data Structures & Memory Layout An array represents a contiguous block of allocated memory that provides constant O(1) random access time complexity for index-based read and write operations. However, inserting or deleting elements from the beginning or middle of an array requires shifting trailing elements, incurring linear O(N) worst-case time complexity. In contrast, singly and doubly linked lists allocate nodes dynamically across the heap using pointers, allowing efficient O(1) insertions at known node references while requiring O(N) sequential traversal to access an arbitrary element by index.
